sources.role: DVS_Sign_v2e event CSVs named by the paper's Data Availability Statement; the only data used
Named by the paper as the DAVIS346 DVS_Sign dataset; rejected because it is a byte-identical 3-class subset of dvs-master

Third-party STBP implementation, not cited by the paper and not this paper's artifact. Selected as the LIF/surrogate-gradient base because its state_update is the paper's Algorithm 1 line for line (including the SpikeAct name) and its steps/dt/Vth hyperparameters and MSE-on-firing-rate loss match Table 3 and Eq. 6. Pinned to the last commit before the paper's 2022-11-30 submission. The repository has no license; it is cloned at image build and not redistributed.
Same GitHub account; README only ('v2e dataset for sign lanuage based event'), no code or data
Reference STBP code for the paper's ref. [29]; considered and rejected as the base because its neuron update, naming and hyperparameters do not match Algorithm 1 / Table 3 as closely as stbp-simple

Not cited by the paper. Its DVS-Gesture CNN 'Input-MP4-64C3-128C3-AP2-128C3-AP2-256FC-11' has the same layout as Figure 3 and supports the 3x3-kernel reading; used only as supporting evidence for a guess
Origin of the copied DVS-Lip rows and of the Acc1/Acc2 caption wording in Table 2

status.numerical_agreement_basis: No in-scope target produced a comparable value: the DVS_Sign_v2e accuracy rests on an unspecified model and training protocol, Acc1/Acc2 are undefined, and the DAVIS346 data is unpublished. Comparability was decided before the full runs were launched. The four conditional runs (final-epoch accuracy 6.67, 6.67, 74.67 and 63.33 against the paper's 77.00) are recorded as evidence and are not assessed for agreement.

blocker.detail: With no code and an underspecified network and training recipe, no run can be a comparable implementation of the requested pipeline; this independently prevents every Table 2 target, including the DAVIS346 row had its data been available. ethics.investigation: The flag concerns the paper's framing and the three volunteers recorded with the DAVIS346 without reported consent. This attempt used only the v2e event streams, which are sparse brightness-change events derived from the already-public LSA64 videos; no DAVIS346 recording of the volunteers was obtained or processed, no new participants were involved, and nothing was published. The survey note that the experiments require a DAVIS346 camera does not apply to rerunning training on published events.

conditional_results.note: Conditional evidence only. These values come from invented protocol choices and are not target results; differences are computed mechanically against the paper's DVS_Sign_v2e row (Acc 77.00, Acc1 79.00, Acc2 76.00). The file-index halves are one unverified reading of Acc1/Acc2. Single seed (1); the 150-file test set makes one file worth 0.67 points.
observations: User observation, 2026-10-02: the best-epoch test accuracy of full-adam-avg (77.33% = 116/150 at epoch 46) is within one test file of the paper's 77.00%. This is consistent with, but does not establish, the hypothesis that the authors trained with the base code's Adam optimizer and reported the best test epoch. It is a maximum over 200 noisy epochs of one seed, chosen on the test set and after seeing four runs, so it stays a diagnostic and does not change any target status.

On a 150-file test set accuracy moves in steps of 0.67 points, so 77.00% is not attainable exactly (115/150 = 76.67, 116/150 = 77.33). All of the paper's own accuracies in Tables 2 and 3 are whole numbers printed with '.00', which suggests rounding to whole percent or a test set of a different size (the paper also mentions an unexplained 'validation set' of 100).
